## b79c14333907

**Reproduced shortcut restriction: generated borders are always wall color 5.**

For generator SHA-256
`cb147553973791f76a74741ae3084ec35a389692502e7a5a5d0efbdcba98082a`
(version `1.3.0`), a 300-draw default census (100 per band, seed 20261007) found
that every border cell in every generated input was color 5. Therefore the
plausible rival “preserve every border cell; apply the intended nearest-seed BFS
only to interior cells” agrees with the entire sampled generator domain.

The canonical first input has open zero border cells. The selected Racket rule
fills those cells, while the border-preserving rival leaves them zero; the two
outputs disagree in 32 cells. Exact inputs/outputs and census counts are in
`checks/audit/b79c14333907/probe.json`,
`canonical_open_border_input.json`, `canonical_open_border_expected.json`, and
`border_preserving_rival.json`. `racket.json` independently confirms the
canonical output under matching rule hash `7cb659dd6c04`. This is a concrete
shortcut/domain-coverage issue, not a claim that the Racket authority is wrong.

## b79c14333907

**Reproduced distribution shortcut: generated inputs always seal the entire border with wall color 5.**

I checked the assigned source SHA-256
`cb147553973791f76a74741ae3084ec35a389692502e7a5a5d0efbdcba98082a`
(version `1.3.0`). A source-bound probe generated 300 ordinary inputs (100 per
band; seed `20261022`, sample indices `0..99`). All 300 passed `self_check`, and
every border cell in all 300 was color 5. This leaves the plausible rival
“apply the nearest-seed BFS rule to the interior but preserve the input border”
unrefuted throughout that sampled generator support.

Canonical pair 0 is an exact lawful disagreement input: it passes the current
`self_check`, has open zero border cells, and the selected Racket authority
recolors 32 border cells. The preserve-border rival leaves those 32 cells
unchanged. The protected-Racket output matches the canonical label and differs
from the rival. Reproducer and full 300-draw census:
`checks/audit/b79c14333907-border/probe.json`; executed authority receipt:
`checks/audit/b79c14333907-border/racket.json`.

This target was audited only and left unchanged. A future repair should include
lawful open-border scenes while keeping both seeds in a common traversable
component, then declare and test the preserve-border rival in complete lessons.
